title: MM6 Gargoyle
description: MM6 living stone gargoyle: dark charcoal gray stony hide, slim humanoid torso, long bent digitigrade legs with splayed clawed feet, small clawed hands, long angular goat-like muzzle with fangs and tiny dark red tongue, two short swept-back head horns and small bright red eyes. Enormous thin pointed bat wings rise above the head with silver-gray ribs and grainy dark membrane. No clothing, weapons, extra tail or muscular redesign. Preserve the exact long-wing silhouette and native claw and snout anatomy. In the native death sequence the entire stone creature breaks into separate angular rock pieces and collapses into a rubble pile; retain each stage and empty gaps, not a flesh corpse.
regions: Stone body and wings recolor to native green or ochre stone. Tiny red eyes have their own native color change; preserve black mouth and fine tooth detail.
